correctness.rationale: Direct equal-distance equation for ellipse circumcenter agrees with 1959 formula and independently executed checker. Torus homomorphism yields independent phases and arcsine Jacobian; Fourier counting gives every mixed moment; positive-definite quadratic form with det 4, dominated convergence and L1 conditional densities give sharp constant and total-variation ellipsoid law. Uniform Taylor and finite-support comparison give the stated O(t) relative probability remainder. Numerical checks are corroboration only.
